decisionProcess.notes: ITU publicly describes travel management services and centralized procurement, including supplier registration through UNGM. A job/circular result also describes supervision of air travel and hotel reservations and large-group travel, but it does not identify the responsible person for this opportunity. The 2025 event note shows host-arranged preferential rates and a designated hotel, suggesting event-specific sourcing can sit with the host/program team.
unknowns: No confirmed future Punta Cana requirement or hotel RFP was identified.
No property-specific official website, address, brand or detailed meeting specification was available in the hotel context.
No verified current hotel-sourcing owner or TMC for the relevant ITU/host activity was found.
No evidence verifies that Robyn Fysh or Emil-Eugen Iuga has authority to contract hotel rooms or meeting space.
The documented 2025 workshop used Santo Domingo and the documented 2026 Punta Cana conference used a competitor hotel; neither proves fit or preference for Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana.
